rule: Finish native CGX + LS private operator first; UniSpace separate product trial and public CGX website only after independent approval and authentic live readback.

phases.name: Native CGX source and identity
requires: Full R0 source/rights reconciliation: original GPT 12 shards and actual manual-intake owner path
current accepted CGX root + four child native acceptance receipts
existing LOAD Object_ID + CCC alias binding
typed R1/R2 source conversions and Frontier review
authentic DBR/root readback
phases.proof: First source-qualified accepted Object_ID and native child readback

phases.name: Unified LS / CGX setup
requires: host BouwerBase online and authorised for install
Python 3.11 runtime dependency/profile checks
single settings owner, no-loss migration from legacy wizards
managed runtime install/update/rollback tests
signed provider/agent node handshake

phases.name: Per-Grex LS GO operator beta
requires: LS GO per-child toggles linked to accepted FileSpace
private static / object-review boundary issue #158
two real node DataSpace exchange issue #161 where relevant
browser+mobile+offline read-only and revoked access negatives
signed owner scope and DBR readback
phases.proof: private operator beta on one grex, then repeat with independent receipts for other children

phases.name: UniSpace product readiness
requires: separate product application, pricing/licence/trial terms and usage rights
CGX capability contract stable, installer/user account and support path
public-safe demo dataset distinct from internal object reviews
positive accessibility/mobile + negative privacy/security suite
distribution package signature and rollback
phases.proof: explicit owner review of testable download/trial and audited public build

phases.name: CGX information website and public communication
requires: approved external claims and architecture explanation
separate CGX core vs UniSpace trial messaging
images/iconography/font/palette and licence verification
source citations, claim confidence, patent/IP/publication rights and legal terms
real HTTPS domain and deployed site readback
outreach recipient/release approval
phases.proof: owner-approved, content-hashed and deployed site; external outreach separately approved

website_information_architecture.description: What the FileSpace/Family Set is, source and authority distinction, one qualified Object_ID; no universal-completeness claim
Cognigrex parent, Grex families, LOAD/Alexandria, CCC typed capabilities, FS/DS sparse hydration, optional LS GO
Minimal library, source-linked knowledge and offline-to-network hydration with licences, no broad archive-mirror claims
Real installed versus registered capabilities, safe demo and release levels; no live solver claims without receipts
Separate consumer/product interface with features only as supported by accepted build
Only enabled after public-safe sample, account/licence, installer/hosting and privacy testing; no fake links
Operator installation, smart setup, user controls, evidence ceilings, source provenance and changelog
Review-qualified, cited factual outputs; speculative, modelling and physical outcomes explicitly distinguished
Accurate controls, data access, IP/licence, external providers, security disclosures and support

user_decisions_for_finish.question: Which CGX and research content is PUBLIC_SAFE versus private/internal or patent-sensitive?
Which UniSpace features and licence/terms define the first free trial?
When BouwerBase reconnects, which accepted root/child carrier and signed owner lease should be admitted?
